first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, so simplifying onboarding directly addresses both current declines and has prior evidence of improving time-to-value and early adoption. A small guarded test should measure activation, completion, qualified revenue, and downstream retention to ensure reduced friction does not lower lead or account quality.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding, since onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%. The verified source shows completion improved 13%, time-to-value fell by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention increased 3%, supporting likely sustainable qualified-revenue impact. Monitor activation, qualified conversion, revenue, and retention to ensure higher completion does not dilute account quality.
